sql: CREATE SCHEMASTORE VIEW orders WITH CONTAINER terms AS SELECT r.as_of AS as_of, r.order_id AS order_id, r.ticker AS ticker, r.order_date AS order_date, r.ship_by AS ship_by, CAST(r.amount_usd AS DOUBLE) AS amount_usd, r.status AS status FROM halden_systems.orders_src LATERAL VIEW explode(records) AS r
